shots.caption: The empty workspace: one prompt, a status strip, and nothing else to learn first.
shots.intent: Show that the prompt is the whole interface. No sidebar, no forms.

shots.intent: Show the live mode suggestion and the send button relabelling.
shots.try: type 'What if the central assumption were reversed?'

shots.caption: The reply appears in a transcript, labelled with the model and mode that produced it.
shots.intent: Show the DEMO label and the reply action buttons.

actions.text: What if the central assumption were reversed?

shots.caption: Clicking a mode pill overrides the guess; click it again to undo.
shots.intent: Show Selected: versus Suggested: wording and the pressed pill.

shots.caption: Changing a control changes the request that is sent.
shots.intent: Show non-default selections that will be sent with the prompt.

shots.caption: Typing a slash lists every command.
shots.intent: Show all eight commands in the suggestion menu.

shots.caption: After /doc the menu offers new, open and list.
shots.intent: Show subcommand suggestions with their hints.
shots.try: type '/doc '

shots.caption: A misspelled command offers a 'Did you mean' fix.
shots.intent: Show the safety net for typos.

shots.caption: /help lists the commands in a short message.
shots.intent: Show the toast after /help.

shots.caption: An unknown command is refused locally instead of being sent to a model.
shots.intent: Show that a slash typo never becomes a chat prompt.

shots.caption: /project new creates a project and switches to it.
shots.intent: Show the status strip changing to the new name.

shots.caption: The menu lists your projects while you type /project switch.
shots.intent: Show project names offered as suggestions.

shots.caption: /project rename changes the name shown in the status strip.
shots.intent: Show the rename result.
shots.try: run '/project rename Renamed'

shots.caption: The pane warns what will be removed and shows the exact command to confirm.
shots.intent: Show the permanence warning with real counts.
shots.try: seed a document and a conversation; type '/project delete'

shots.caption: The project and everything in it is gone, and you land in another project.
shots.intent: Show the confirmation message and the surviving project.
shots.try: seed extra_projects ['Scratch']; run '/project switch Scratch' then '/project delete Scratch'

shots.caption: /model lists every provider and marks the one in use.
shots.intent: Show configured versus not configured providers.

shots.intent: Show the refusal text and that the model did not change.

shots.intent: Show the [DEMO RESPONSE] banner in a reply.

shots.step: Open a document to edit it
